verdict.rationale: Deel's founders page lists the visa types it handles (O-1A, EB-2 NIW, L-1, E-2, H-1B) and says it helps founders, but nothing in the pack explains how a founder's own startup can petition for them. There is no coverage of beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer-control arrangements, or the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance. Generic employer-sponsored permits through your own entities is an adjacent capability, not founder self-petition documentation.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents how my own startup can petition for me — beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer control arrangements, and the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance
